route_title: Dual-cavity bandpass filter using ZnS/MgF2 on Daimon-20 substrate
compilation_rationale: Resolved ZnS and MgF2 via registry. Fixed 22-layer alternating stack compiled sequentially. Spectral bounds set to 3500–5300 nm to encompass all pass/stop bands. Four mean transmittance targets enforce band-specific optimization. Coherent TMM selected for interference filtering. Quarter-wave initial thickness chosen with symmetric bounds covering mid-IR dispersion.
